WITH RichHouseholds AS (
  SELECT head_of_household_id
  FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index
  WHERE wealth_level = 'Rich'
),
NonRichHouseholds AS (
  SELECT head_of_household_id
  FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index
  WHERE wealth_level != 'Rich'
),
SaudiWomenInRich AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as total_rich_women
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN RichHouseholds r ON d.head_of_household_id = r.head_of_household_id
  WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi'
    AND d.gender = 'F'
    AND d.person_status = 'صالح'
    AND d.death_date IS NULL
),
SaudiWomenWithPostgradInRich AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as rich_women_with_postgrad
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN RichHouseholds r ON d.head_of_household_id = r.head_of_household_id
  JOIN estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala u ON d.id = u.id
  WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi'
    AND d.gender = 'F'
    AND d.person_status = 'صالح'
    AND d.death_date IS NULL
    AND u.qualification IN ('ماجستير', 'دكتوراه')
    AND u.graduation_date IS NOT NULL
),
SaudiWomenInNonRich AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as total_nonrich_women
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN NonRichHouseholds nr ON d.head_of_household_id = nr.head_of_household_id
  WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi'
    AND d.gender = 'F'
    AND d.person_status = 'صالح'
    AND d.death_date IS NULL
),
SaudiWomenWithPostgradInNonRich AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as nonrich_women_with_postgrad
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN NonRichHouseholds nr ON d.head_of_household_id = nr.head_of_household_id
  JOIN estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala u ON d.id = u.id
  WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi'
    AND d.gender = 'F'
    AND d.person_status = 'صالح'
    AND d.death_date IS NULL
    AND u.qualification IN ('ماجستير', 'دكتوراه')
    AND u.graduation_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT total_rich_women FROM SaudiWomenInRich) as total_rich_women,
  (SELECT rich_women_with_postgrad FROM SaudiWomenWithPostgradInRich) as rich_women_with_postgrad,
  ROUND((SELECT rich_women_with_postgrad FROM SaudiWomenWithPostgradInRich) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT total_rich_women FROM SaudiWomenInRich), 2) as rich_women_postgrad_pct,
  (SELECT total_nonrich_women FROM SaudiWomenInNonRich) as total_nonrich_women,
  (SELECT nonrich_women_with_postgrad FROM SaudiWomenWithPostgradInNonRich) as nonrich_women_with_postgrad,
  ROUND((SELECT nonrich_women_with_postgrad FROM SaudiWomenWithPostgradInNonRich) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT total_nonrich_women FROM SaudiWomenInNonRich), 2) as nonrich_women_postgrad_pct
